definitions.explanation: A film produced in Western countries (Europe, America, etc.), as distinguished from Japanese or Asian cinema. A broad classification used in Japanese film culture.

examples.japanese: {西洋映画|せいようえいが}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{西洋映画|せいようえいが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洋画|ようが}→洋画：14741_youga⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}んでいた→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: In the past, Western films were called yōga.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画館|えいがかん}→映画館：01024_eigakan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{西洋映画|せいようえいが}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{邦画|ほうが}→邦画：14740_houga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上映|じょうえい}→上映：08380_jouei⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This movie theater screens both Western films and Japanese films.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{西洋|せいよう}→西洋：01446_seiyou⟧ (the West/Western countries) and ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧ (movie). In everyday Japanese, ⟦{洋画|ようが}→洋画：14741_youga⟧ is the more common and concise term for Western films. {西洋映画|せいようえいが} is the fuller, more formal expression.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {西洋映画|せいようえいが}⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧: fan of Western movies
- {西洋映画|せいようえいが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧: masterpiece of Western cinema
- {西洋映画|せいようえいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観|み}る→観る：22793_miru⟧: to watch a Western movie

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{洋画|ようが}→洋画：14741_youga⟧: Western film — the standard short form, much more common in casual speech
- ⟦{邦画|ほうが}→邦画：14740_houga⟧: Japanese film — the counterpart category
- {外国映画|がいこくえいが}: foreign film — broader, includes Asian films too
